courses.overview: 以可遷移的原理、量測與驗證比較相近儀器；關聯不表示同一廠商、世代或驗收規格。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 非球面光學加工
related.transfer: 可遷移「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」與「拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；非球面光學加工的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom" and "Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Aspheric-optics manufacturing must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦自由曲面的基準配準、CGH 與傾斜波干涉、探針輪廓、拼接與不確定度追溯；非球面光學加工則以非球面矢高方程、中頻誤差、確定性拋光、鑽石車削與模造、非球面量測與對心公差為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on datum registration, CGH and tilted-wave interferometry, probe profiling, stitching and traceable uncertainty for freeform surfaces; Aspheric-optics manufacturing centres on aspheric sag equation, mid-spatial-frequency error, deterministic polishing, diamond turning and molding, asphere metrology and centring tolerances, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「自由曲面定義與基準座標」與「非球面矢高方程與圓錐常數」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到非球面光學加工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「非球面對心靈敏度與誤差預算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Freeform definition and datum frame” and “Aspheric sag equation and conic constant”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Aspheric-optics manufacturing, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Aspheric centring sensitivity and the error budget", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

related.title: 白光干涉表面輪廓儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」與「拼接量測與傾斜波的誤差累積」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；白光干涉表面輪廓儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom" and "Error accumulation in stitching and tilted-wave measurement" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of White-light interferometric profilometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦自由曲面的基準配準、CGH 與傾斜波干涉、探針輪廓、拼接與不確定度追溯；白光干涉表面輪廓儀則以低相干包絡定位、Mirau 干涉物鏡、垂直掃描與 ISO 25178 計量特性校正為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on datum registration, CGH and tilted-wave interferometry, probe profiling, stitching and traceable uncertainty for freeform surfaces; White-light interferometric profilometers centres on low-coherence envelope localisation, Mirau interference objectives, vertical scanning and ISO 25178 metrological-characteristic calibration, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「自由曲面定義與基準座標」與「寬頻光源與零光程差包絡」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到白光干涉表面輪廓儀，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「蝙蝠翼、異材相位與薄膜干擾」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Freeform definition and datum frame” and “Broadband source and zero-OPD envelope”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to White-light interferometric profilometers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Batwing artefacts, dissimilar-material phase and thin-film interference", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 自由曲面光學量測
history.text: 電腦全像片零位測試在 1970 年代由 Wyant 等人建立，使非球面與離軸面能用干涉儀驗收；2000 年代鑽石車削的慢刀伺服與確定性拋光讓自由曲面可以製造，量測成為瓶頸，於是出現 QED 的次口徑拼接干涉儀、斯圖加特大學 ITO 發展的傾斜波干涉儀與 PTB 的可追溯非球面量測；2013 年美國 NSF 支持羅徹斯特大學與北卡羅來納大學夏洛特分校成立自由曲面光學中心（CeFO），2015 年 ISO 10110-19 訂定自由曲面的規格標示方式。本課只整理公開的量測原理。
history.textEn: Computer-generated-hologram null testing was established by Wyant and colleagues in the 1970s, allowing aspheres and off-axis surfaces to be accepted interferometrically; in the 2000s slow-tool-servo diamond turning and deterministic polishing made freeforms manufacturable and metrology became the bottleneck, prompting QED's subaperture stitching interferometer, the tilted-wave interferometer developed at ITO University of Stuttgart and traceable asphere metrology at PTB; in 2013 the US NSF supported the University of Rochester and UNC Charlotte in founding the Center for Freeform Optics (CeFO), and in 2015 ISO 10110-19 defined how freeform surfaces are specified. This course compiles only public metrology principles.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「無對稱軸的量測對象：自由曲面與剛體自由度」到「獨立方法交叉驗證與驗收交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "A measurand without symmetry: freeforms and rigid-body freedom" through "Independent-method cross-validation and acceptance handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
